I am running the existing event listener and commit tests to verify the baseline environment.
I have completed wiring the durability tracker and `BatchDurable` callback into `db.go` and `open.go`, and started running the existing test suite to verify compilation and behavior. I will review the test results once the run finishes.
I have added unit tests in [durability_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/durability_test.go) and launched the test suite with `-race`. I will check the results once the test run completes.

I updated `TestDurabilityErrorFsInjection` in [durability_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/durability_test.go) to match `errorfs.OpFileSyncData` in addition to `errorfs.OpFileSync`, and re-ran the tests with `-race`. I will check the results once the test run finishes.
I have implemented `EventListener.BatchDurable` and the `DB` durability waiting, notification, and inspection APIs on the `batch-durable` branch:

- **`EventListener` & `WriteOptions`**:
  - Added [`BatchDurableInfo`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/event.go#L675-L686) and `EventListener.BatchDurable func(BatchDurableInfo)` in [event.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/event.go), wired through [`EventListener.EnsureDefaults`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/event.go#L884-L999), [`MakeLoggingEventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/event.go#L1003-L1150), and [`TeeEventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/event.go#L1153-L1330).
  - Added `CommitCorrelationID uint64` and [`WriteOptions.GetCommitCorrelationID`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/options.go#L129-L138) in [options.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/options.go).
- **Commit Pipeline & Durability Tracking**:
  - Updated [`commitPipeline.Commit`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/commit.go#L300-L411) and [`commitPipeline.prepare`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/commit.go#L486-L546) in [commit.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/commit.go), [`Batch.SyncWait`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/batch.go#L1707-L1722) in [batch.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/batch.go), and [`DB.applyInternal`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/db.go#L788-L853) / [`DB.commitWrite`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/db.go#L891-L974) in [db.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/db.go) to measure `ApplyDuration` and `SyncDuration` wall-clock durations and fire `BatchDurable` once per `Sync` commit (including on WAL sync failures) while skipping non-sync commits and `DisableWAL`.
  - Implemented [`DurabilityStats`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/durability.go#L42-L50) and the `DB` durability methods ([`WaitForDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/durability.go#L412-L414), [`WaitForDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/durability.go#L419-L427), [`WaitForDurabilityBatch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/durability.go#L431-L433), [`WaitForDurabilityBatchContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/durability.go#L438-L454), [`WaitForJobDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/durability.go#L459-L461), [`WaitForJobDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/durability.go#L466-L474), [`DurableState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/durability.go#L478-L480), [`DurabilityNotify`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/durability.go#L485-L497), and [`DurabilityStats`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/durability.go#L500-L502)) in [durability.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/durability.go).
- **Metrics & Tests**:
  - Exposed `DurableCommitCount` and `DurableCommitDuration` on [`Metrics`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/metrics.go#L285-L291) in [metrics.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/metrics.go) and populated them in [`DB.Metrics`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nvaw9_6h/db.go#L2106) only when `BatchDurable` is configured.
